description:
Add JUnit unit tests to the NotepadApp Android project. The project is already open in Android Studio and has three main classes that need test coverage:

1. NoteValidator - has methods: isValidTitle, isValidContent, isNoteComplete, isValidId, isValidColor
2. NoteFormatter - has methods: formatTitle, formatPreview, formatDate, formatWordCount
3. Note - data class with helper methods: wordCount, charCount

Create test files in app/src/test/java/com/example/notepad/:
- NoteValidatorTest.kt - test all validation methods with both valid and invalid inputs
- NoteFormatterTest.kt - test all formatting methods
- NoteTest.kt - test Note data class helper methods

Each test file should have at least 3 test methods. After creating the tests, run them using the test runner to verify they all pass.
